maya: :loudspeaker: Heads-up: next major change to billing metering — we're moving from raw token counts to a 'compute-unit' (CU) metering model to better reflect model size, context length, and execution cost. This is a behaviorally transparent billing backend change (no change to your request/response body), rollout plan below.

zane: Will the invoice look different? customers will freak if line items change.

maya: Invoices will include a new 'Compute Units' line. For the first 60 days we'll also show a token-equivalent column so customers can reconcile with historical usage. No retroactive charges. We'll apply a one-time conversion credit for legacy billed customers to smooth the first cycle.

finance-bot: Note: conversion credits applied automatically for legacy accounts within 2 billing cycles. See internal billing doc for thresholds.

emily: For engineers: API surface doesn't change today. We'll add two response headers to help observability: `X-Redwood-CU-Estimate` (approx CU used this request) and `X-Redwood-CU-Type` (inference|embedding|rerank). Example:

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Client: my-app" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
# response headers: X-Redwood-CU-Estimate: 12, X-Redwood-CU-Type: inference
```

emily: We'll also surface a per-request CU estimate in the Console logs for the next 90 days so engineers can map their workloads.

maya: Important: new tiered throttling limits tied to plans — this is separate from monthly commit. Rough defaults: free/trial = 10 CU/s, dev/team = 200 CU/s, enterprise = 2000 CU/s with configurable burst windows. Throttling will return 429 + `Retry-After` and a `X-Redwood-CU-Available` header. We'll offer per-account overrides for Dedicated and Private customers.

zane: How will we communicate limits so customers don't get surprised during launch?

maya: Multiple vectors: in-console banner + email to billing contacts + pre-launch usage alerts at 50/80/95% of monthly commit. Also a new 'predictive guardrail' opt-in beta that will auto-pause non-critical jobs when forecasted spend crosses a user-defined threshold.

thomas: Legal reviewed the customer-facing language. Need to clarify refund policy for converted usage in the FAQ and add VAT/residency callouts.

maya: Agreed — finance and legal will update the FAQ. Timeline: internal alpha next week, opt-in customer beta in 30 days, full rollout (default on new accounts) in 90 days. Migration credits for first 2 months after opt-in.

ops-bot: :gear: Rolling plan created: https://internal.redwood.tools/ops/metering-rollout (internal-only).

maya: Action items: @zane - confirm invoice line wording & sample PDF; @emily - add CU headers to staging and Console; @thomas - update FAQ/legal text; @support-billing - prepare customer comms. Please escalate any risk to #exec-briefing by EOD Friday. :chart_with_upwards_trend: :thumbsup:
